Welcome to Pretty Bags of Rocks

This is a small idea, done carefully: beautiful polished rocks, gathered into little bags you can keep, gift, sort, line up on a windowsill, or pour into a bowl just because they look good there.

Every stone is tumbled and polished until it is smooth to hold and bright in the light. Every bag is a mix, so opening one is part of the fun — no two bags, and no two stones, are exactly alike.

About Pretty Bags of Rocks

Pretty Bags of Rocks is a small shop based in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan. It began with rocks collected for a grandpa's tumbler — and now a daughter gathers them for her mom to polish. Every stone is tumbled smooth, checked by hand, and packed by hand.
